title: Dataset Registry (short folder id <-> dataset)
description: Authoritative mapping between short GCS folder ids and full dataset work-unit ids, + GCS URIs. Kept on HPCC local host and mirrored into the bucket.

testset_version.description: frozen test-set version this registry belongs to (e.g. 2026.08.1)

folder_id.description: <genome_id>_<stressor>_<NNN> per ADR-013; contamination tiers carry lo/md/hi suffix

seed_root.description: root seed used for this dataset's generation (from source_reads.seed)
